state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body`, `bytes`, `bodyStream`, `clientIp`, `cookie`, `files`,
`header` and `headers` have all their feature proofs. `bun nv proofs --verify --only` over those eight
says nothing owed. A proof program answers a request through the `<name>.nvsr` beside it
(`docs/examples/README.md` § *A request for the program*, and `crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`'s module
doc for every section). A new bench is measured with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <members>`.
`bun nv verify` regenerates `docs/novis.md` from the rewritten cards. Three members of
`Core\Request (1/2)` still owe their proofs: `host`, `isHead` and `json`, in that order.
